description: This file defines multiple enum classes representing various capabilities, commands, and related constants for the OpenClaw protocol used within the app. It includes capability identifiers and command strings for different device functionalities such as camera, SMS, location, device info, notifications, system actions, photos, contacts, calendar, motion, and call log.

classes.name: OpenClawCapability
classes.description: Enum class representing various capabilities like camera, sms, location, etc., each with an associated raw string value.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasCommand
classes.description: Enum class representing commands for canvas operations, with a companion object defining the namespace prefix.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UICommand
classes.description: Enum class for canvas A2UI commands with associated raw values and a namespace prefix constant.

classes.description: Enum class for camera commands, with a namespace prefix constant.
